title: 2194. Calculating the Total Price with GST Using a Symbolic Constant
description:
2194
. 
Calculating the Total Price with GST Using a Symbolic Constant
10
Easy
Problem Statement
Read the price of an item and print the total price after adding GST, using a symbolic constant for the GST rate.
Description
A shop adds 18 percent GST to the price of every item. Define a symbolic constant GST_RATE with the value 18 using #define. Read the price of an item as a float from input, calculate the total price using the formula total = price + price * GST_RATE / 100, and print the total with exactly two digits after the decimal point.
Input Description
A single positive number price (it may have decimals).
Output Description
Print the total price after adding GST, with two digits after the decimal point.
Sample Input
1000
Sample Output
1180.00
